The piecewise form is
\[
|x-1|+|x-3|=
\begin{cases}
4-2x, & x<1,\\
2, & 1\le x<3,\\
2x-4, & x\ge 3.
\end{cases}
\]
Intersections with \(y=8\):
\[
4-2x=8 \implies x=-2,\qquad 2x-4=8 \implies x=6.
\]
So the area is
\[
\int_{-2}^{1}\bigl(8-(4-2x)\bigr)\,dx
+\int_{1}^{3}(8-2)\,dx
+\int_{3}^{6}\bigl(8-(2x-4)\bigr)\,dx.
\]
Compute:
\[
\int_{-2}^{1}(4+2x)\,dx=9,
\]
\[
\int_{1}^{3}6\,dx=12,
\]
\[
\int_{3}^{6}(12-2x)\,dx=9.
\]
Thus the total area is
\[
9+12+9=30.
\]
\[
\boxed{30}
\]
